objective.primaryRule: No primary and no roles: nothing is searched for selection, ranked or selected (AD1). The study measures concurrency and batching of the accepted GPU evaluator, verifies bit-identical results and isolation, fixes one type-only error and renews the acceptance; its outcomes are measured figures, the frozen decision rules R1-R5 (PROTOCOL.md section 8) and engineering gates (sections 9-10).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: No search proposals for selection. backendEvaluations caps fresh CPU reference pooled simulations on real data (the parity campaign's CPU references, the CPU arm of the parity-only mini-optimization, the CPU samples of the pool benchmarks and of the reliability run). GPU evaluations (non-official benchmarks, replays of sealed jobs, parity runs) are counted separately in the records; synthetic fixtures are not counted.

evaluationBackend.justification: Engineering benchmark and acceptance study (GPU Phase 4): GPU runs are non-official benchmarks and identity checks of replays of sealed jobs and seeded configurations on the accepted binary; the acceptance campaign runs non-official parity tests whose CPU evaluations are parity references. Nothing is official optimization evidence (standard 3.0.0 section 9.8); the study's engineering output is a new acceptance record (section 9.9) for the final code.

chronologicalConsequence: not applicable: a diagnostic with no search for selection and no chronological verdict (AD2)

deviations.description: no roles and no primary; nothing is selected
deviations.justification: brief: engineering assignment; no trading rule, candidate, risk gate, objective, genome, optimizer or finding changes

deviations.description: no search for selection, no chronological verdict; sealed jobs of Assignments 3 and 2 replayed with their own frozen code and seeds, and the parity-only mini schedule, compared by identity only
deviations.justification: brief §1: representative, fixed and reproducible workloads drawn from sealed evaluation/search behaviour

deviations.description: D19 and FULL (and in the acceptance campaign every door and fixture of Phase 3's campaign) opened quietly through the study's own door log for replays and seeded timing/parity configurations
deviations.justification: brief §1, §4: benchmark replays and parity on short and long doors

deviations.description: the CPU engine is the unmodified canonical reference; every concurrent, split or re-batched run must reproduce the canonical or sealed records bit for bit
not applicable: no fold primary or final candidate
concurrency, worker-count and batch-size measurements are the study's subject (engineering of the evaluator's use), not a search's tuning pilot
stricter: no money figure of any configuration; identity booleans, counts, hashes and timings only
deviations.justification: brief: no new strategy research findings

deviations.description: benchmarks of minutes and one bounded 30-35 min reliability run on the final code instead of an endurance test
deviations.justification: brief §1, §4: minutes, not multi-hour endurance runs; one bounded 30-60 minute reliability check

deviations.description: the risk-envelope pilot is out of scope: nothing of it is created, implemented, preflighted or run
deviations.justification: brief: non-negotiable scope boundary (the user's instructions take precedence, §0.4)
